**In one line**: Palantir is reported to counter the dismissal that it is merely an "LLM wrapper" riding the AI boom with its financial results, even as its stock has pulled back from a recent peak.

### Key points
- Some skeptics have downplayed Palantir as an "LLM wrapper" — a company that only packages large language models.
- The outlet argues Palantir's financial metrics run counter to that simplistic critique.
- Even so, the stock has retreated from a recent peak, and the valuation debate continues.

### Why it matters
The central question hanging over AI-linked stocks is whether there's a real business underneath or just froth riding the hype. The Palantir debate is a clear case in point — the gap between its own data-and-software results and a share price shaped by AI expectations.
